content_of_post_to_answer: Why does a person take alcohol? Is it his weakness or happiness?
answer: Alcohol is rarely just about weakness or happiness. For many people, it begins as a way to change an uncomfortable internal state — stress, loneliness, anxiety, boredom, or even celebration. The danger is when a temporary escape quietly becomes the only available escape. I've explored this pattern in more detail on my profile for anyone who wants to understand the psychology behind such choices. The real question is not why someone drinks, but what feeling they are trying not to face.
